titles.synopsis: Airport Chaplain Tobias Wallace is convinced the airport couldn’t possibly run without his 24/7 devotion. But new Terminal Manager Mira Ansari-Cole is convinced he’s a walking liability.

titles.title: Totally '90s House
titles.synopsis: Follows two teams of '90s television idols with a passion for design and renovation as they scour the country for houses stuck in the 1990s - think honey oak cabinets, sponge-painted walls and mirrored closets - with each team ultimately picking their perfect throwback in need of a major overhaul.

titles.title: Wishbone Kitchen
titles.synopsis: Pull up a kitchen stool and press play. Each week, Meredith Hayden — the voice behind Wishbone Kitchen — sits down to talk cozy, crave-worthy recipes, real kitchen tips, and the small rituals that turn a house into a home. It's the kind of podcast that makes you want to light a candle, pour a glass of wine, and press record on your own kitchen story.

titles.title: Death of the Pastor's Wife
titles.synopsis: What happened to Mica Miller? This documentary series retraces her promising life, toxic marriage and the mysterious circumstances of her death.

titles.title: Mom Knows Best?
titles.synopsis: Nine mothers compete to prove they know their children best; they wager money on predicting their children's choices and discover that their children can still surprise them.

titles.title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young
titles.synopsis: After delivering one of the greatest performances in Rose Bowl history, Texas Longhorns legend Vince Young was the NFL's next big thing, and for a while, he was. But a career riddled by injuries, conflict and sudden loss tells a far more complicated story than the highlight reels ever showed.

titles.title: Stamptown
titles.synopsis: Blending the wild worlds of circus and comedy, anarchic acts collide for this raunchy and explicit variety show - clothing not guaranteed.

titles.title: Pickleballers
titles.synopsis: When Max Dangerfield's anger issues get her strapped with $25,000 in fines, she's completely lost on how to dig herself out.  Luckily, her two best friends Charlotte and Spence have an idea. The internet show sensation 'Balloon Shop' is having a pickleball tournament with a huge cash prize. The only problem - none of them know what pickleball is.  With an array of unhinged new friends support, Max and her new partner Lexi are ready to take it all on. The only wall in their way is Rachel Summers. The token town mean girl with a vendetta aimed right at Max's forehead.  Rachel hires a 5 time tournament winning pickleball player as her partner to ensure Max and Lexi stand no chance at all.  So, with the odds stacked against them the gang have no choice but to give it everything they've got.

titles.title: Dolly Parton: An American Original – Special Edition of 20/20
titles.synopsis: Celebrating Dolly Parton's life, music and legacy -- featuring never-before-seen interviews with Dolly herself, unforgettable interviews with Robin Roberts and Barbara Walters, and reflections from those who knew her best.

titles.title: Spark
titles.synopsis: An investigative journalist takes on a massive bank scam, challenging a powerful cop—and soon uncovers a deadly conspiracy that leads straight to its hidden mastermind.

titles.title: Anchorage Point
titles.synopsis: World renown architect struggles with the weight of his failed bridge design and the lives it claimed

titles.title: Oozhi
titles.synopsis: After two years apart, Lenin and Megha unexpectedly meet at a stargazing camp. When Lenin discovers an alien stone that takes him back into the memories and guilt of their past, he sees a chance to fix what he broke.

titles.title: The Great American Journey
titles.synopsis: The Great American Journey will travel the country celebrating American history and exploring the people, places and ideas that have shaped our nation. The series will examine how the American story continues to evolve and the role each generation plays in defining what comes next.

titles.title: The Marching Band
titles.synopsis: A world-famous orchestra conductor discovers the brother he never knew he had — a school cafeteria worker who plays trombone in a local marching band. Detecting his brother's exceptional musical talent, he takes it upon himself to rectify the injustice of fate.

titles.title: The Magic Faraway Tree
titles.synopsis: A modern family relocates to the countryside where the children discover a magical tree with eccentric residents. They're transported to fantastical lands, rekindling their family bond through adventures.

titles.title: Colours of Time
titles.synopsis: When four distant cousins inherit a 19th-century home in Normandy, they decide to visit and examine their family history. No one has lived there since the 1940s, and the cousins are intrigued by all of the items they find there, little things that help them to understand their ancestor, Adèle Vermillard. Jumping back and forth in time, they meet the mysterious Adèle, whose bohemian lifestyle, and her relationships with the leading artists of the time, changes their lives.

titles.title: Mutiny
titles.synopsis: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

titles.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
titles.synopsis: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

titles.title: OK! Madam: Bon Voyage
titles.synopsis: Six years after the Hawaii airplane hijacking, Mi-yeong finds herself struggling with her rebellious teenage daughter, Nari, and her unemployed husband, Seok-hwan. When Hyun-min, a flight attendant she met during the hijacking, invites her family to his wedding aboard a luxury cruise ship, Mi-yeong eagerly proposes a family holiday. Met with indifference from her husband and daughter, she decides to embark alone, joining Hyun-min's family and Ji-hoon, a charming magician. However, on the eve of the wedding, the celebration turns deadly when armed assailants seize the ship. After Seok-hwan and Nari are kidnapped and brought aboard, Mi-yeong discovers that she is the target of a much larger plot.

titles.title: 7 Dogs
titles.synopsis: Interpol agent Khalid Al-Azzazi joins forces with Ghali Abu Dawood from the 7 Dogs crime syndicate to fight drug trafficking.

titles.title: Spa Weekend
titles.synopsis: Four lifelong friends realize that somewhere between careers, relationships, families, and everyday responsibilities, they’ve forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.

titles.title: It Ends
titles.synopsis: A group of recent grads head out on a late night drive for grub, hoping to enjoy one final hangout before their paths diverge. Instead, they accidentally turn onto a never-ending, two-lane hellscape surrounded by untold horrors and cosmic forces beyond their understanding. Cramped together inside a Jeep Cherokee and with the miles stretching infinitely ahead, they face a choice: embrace their new existence or fight to escape it.

titles.title: Irumudi
titles.synopsis: An alcoholic with a violent past—living peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall—decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha (a 41-day spiritual vow and period of intense austerity) at her request.

titles.title: All That We Never Were
titles.synopsis: 19-year-old Leah navigates a coming-of-age journey in the wake of a tragic car accident that claims her parents. Relocated to a coastal town under the care of her brother’s best friend Axel, Leah grapples with grief, haunting nightmares and a fractured sense of self.

titles.title: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
titles.synopsis: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

titles.title: How to Divorce During the War
titles.synopsis: Vilnius 2022. High-flying executive Marija chooses the worst possible moment for an honest conversation with her husband Vytas about divorcing - just one day before Russia’s invasion of Ukraine goes into full scale. Now they must navigate the process of separation as it collides with a refugee and mid-life crisis.

titles.title: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam
titles.synopsis: When a bride refuses to leave her family home after marriage, her husband must find out if he can adjust to life under his in-laws' roof.

titles.title: Ram and Leela
titles.synopsis: The story revolves around a 30-year-old man whose family is searching for a suitable bride For his marriage. At the same time, he is also hoping to find true love, but nothing works out. Eventually, he meets a young woman named Leela, they fall in love, face several Unexpected challenges and twists, and finally overcome them to unite

titles.title: Facing El Chapo
titles.synopsis: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.

titles.title: Kadhal Aura
titles.synopsis: Two men with opposite beliefs about love and God are cursed to swap souls, forcing them to live each other's lives and face the women they love.

titles.title: Judaa
titles.synopsis: A young man sacrifices his chance at love to preserve a cherished friendship. When loss reshapes their lives, he carries forward an unfulfilled dream of universal education, keeping alive the memory of the woman who inspired it.

titles.title: Modha Rathri
titles.synopsis: Two strangers are brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

titles.title: LEGO Disney Princess: Magical Mayhem
titles.synopsis: During a heavy rainstorm, the Princess characters and their sidekick friends take in animals in need while enjoying a cozy day in their castle. But when the animals run amok, chaos erupts. Sleuthing reveals a mischievous villain behind it all, and with teamwork, quick thinking, and help from an unexpected friend, the Princess characters must restore order and save their home.

titles.title: Harrd Disk
titles.synopsis: Entrusted with a hard disk believed to hold information that could topple ministers, a young boy gets caught in a deadly game between a cop and a political fixer. Everybody wants it. No one knows what's inside.

titles.title: Ameer Log
titles.synopsis: Three carefree friends from a bustling Hyderabad basti spend their days wandering narrow lanes, sharing plates of biryani, and dreaming of a better life. When an old cook's secret recipe brings unexpected success their way, they must choose between fleeting fame and the enduring value of friendship, memories, and the taste of home.

titles.title: The Red Bag
titles.synopsis: Four women trapped in a deadly human-trafficking empire steal a mysterious red bag and race through betrayal, violence, and relentless pursuit, only to discover the bag holds a secret powerful enough to change everything.

titles.title: Bardaasht
titles.synopsis: After being falsely imprisoned, Karma returns to his village determined to take revenge on the man who destroyed his family.

titles.title: Hot Spot
titles.synopsis: Set in a near future society ruled by sentient A.I., a private eye investigates a murder case only to discover a rebel group capable of undermining the digital overlord. As the detective's identity slowly unravels, his world enters a state of hypnotic meltdown.

titles.title: 9/11: Reunited
titles.synopsis: The story of September 11 through the eyes of survivors who experienced life-or-death moments with strangers that day and now want to meet again.

titles.title: The Girls: A Khloé Kardashian Project
titles.synopsis: They're building empires. They're building families. They're always unfiltered. Welcome to The Girls, where Khloé Kardashian's inner circle of real-life besties are raising babies, running businesses, and surviving brutally honest group chats. From surprise proposals to solo parenting, glam getaways to growing pains, this is the new era of reality TV where the chaos is couture — and the bonds are unbreakable.

titles.title: Khalifa: The Ruler
titles.synopsis: Aamir Ali, a notorious gold smuggling kingpin who inherited his multi-million dollar criminal enterprise from a lineage of gangsters, is drawn into a web of vengeance, legacy and power.

titles.title: He Loves Me Not
titles.synopsis: An aspiring actress chosen as a wild card for a reality TV dating show uses a secret elixir to win the heart of the star, but when her deception is revealed, she discovers a messy but real chance for love.

titles.title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
titles.synopsis: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

titles.title: Chompoo: Lost​ &​ Forgotten​
titles.synopsis: When a young girl vanishes from a remote village, the frantic police hunt become a media frenzy. But who turned a suspected criminal into a celebrity?

titles.title: Kudiyan Shehar Diyan
titles.synopsis: Three ambitious women leave their small towns for the city, chasing successful careers while facing tough choices that threaten their relationships, values, and identities.

titles.title: The Dynasty: UConn Huskies
titles.synopsis: Go inside the most dominant program in college basketball history as Geno Auriemma pushes his players to the limit to win 12 titles. Rebecca Lobo, Diana Taurasi, Paige Bueckers, and more reveal what it takes to survive UConn and build a dynasty.

titles.title: Blood Sacrifice
titles.synopsis: Following the brutal murder of two police officers, a tenacious detective reluctantly joins forces with his estranged ex-cop father to catch the killer.

titles.title: S&X
titles.synopsis: At his clinic, sex therapist Ichito Shimotori treats diverse and intimate sexual issues with sincerity. Yet, he secretly hides a struggle of his own.

titles.title: Outer Banks: The Official Podcast
titles.synopsis: Host Ria Ciuffo sits down with Outer Banks stars Chase Stokes, Madelyn Cline, Carlacia Grant, Jonathan Daviss, and Madison Bailey to celebrate the series' five-season run.

titles.title: Abijit Ganguly: Baby
titles.synopsis: Stand-up special

titles.title: Lion
titles.synopsis: The extraordinary true story of lion cub Kio, on his journey to become a king.

titles.title: A Beautiful Obsession
titles.synopsis: An intimate, raw portrait of Manchester City FC across two era-defining seasons. With unprecedented access, the film follows their worst run in decades and fightback to glory.

titles.title: Back to the 90s
titles.synopsis: When a mysterious glitch sends a rising boyband back to 1995 - just days before the biggest showcase of their lives - the five friends race to reverse the time slip. But as unexpected connections form and the past pulls them in deeper, getting home means confronting what they're willing to leave behind - and who they truly are to each other.

titles.title: Kelsey Cook: Happy Hour
titles.synopsis: In this candid and clever stand-up special, Kelsey Cook explores "hangxiety," relives a plane bathroom nightmare and breaks down dating a literal Chad.

titles.title: Sapan Verma: Lower Back Pain
titles.synopsis: Stand-up comedy special by Span Verma

titles.title: Insecta
titles.synopsis: A celebrated horror novelist returns to an isolated estate to say goodbye to her dying father, only to discover that the monstrous imaginary insect that tormented her childhood may have been real all along.

titles.title: Take a Hike!
titles.synopsis: Four celebrity hiking newbies end up forming a club to tackle Korea's snow‑capped peaks. Can they figure out why on earth people go to the mountains?

titles.title: Cradle of Coaches
titles.synopsis: This documentary delves into the history of remarkable leaders, their groundbreaking achievements, and the profound connections that have shaped football’s greatest coaching legacy.

titles.title: World's Most Evil Women
titles.synopsis: World's Most Evil Women unmasks those who traded compassion for cruelty, committing acts so horrific they shattered entire communities.

titles.title: Disney Worldbuilders
titles.synopsis: We sit down with some of the key figures shaping Disney’s most enduring stories for a series of intimate conversations about their early years, first sparks, and formative Disney memories — and how the worlds they once dreamed up are now taking shape at Disney destinations around the globe.

titles.title: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration
titles.synopsis: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration at Disneyland Resort brings together the largest gathering of Disney Princess stars ever assembled, celebrating the iconic stories across animation, live-action, stage, and music. This one-of-a-kind concert will transform the night skies with dazzling lights, sweeping projections, and sky-high fountains creating a truly immersive world where the music, magic, and legacy of Disney Princesses shine like never before.

titles.title: Wolfsbane
titles.synopsis: Combe Noire forest, French Alps. The daughter of a troubled man comes to gather his things, 6 months after her father went missing. She soon realizes that something unnatural is happening in Combe Noire, and that Mother Earth might be sending her hounds onto us.

titles.title: Assembly Required
titles.synopsis: A grieving man receives an unexpected package.

titles.title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
titles.synopsis: From ordinary lives to extraordinary drama. Aspiring contestants fight to earn a spot in the Bigg Boss house.

titles.title: Lanterns
titles.synopsis: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

titles.title: Hushar Pittalu
titles.synopsis: In a village, two teenagers, Ravi and Chitti, are drawn into a secret relationship as curiosity, adolescence, and bad influences shape their choices. When their families discover the affair, the couple defies them, setting off a chain of events that reveals how parental mistakes, peer pressure, and youthful attraction can alter young lives forever.

titles.title: 108 Base Hospital Uri
titles.synopsis: Resilient army doctors at 108 Base Hospital, Uri, navigate personal and professional battles whilst saving lives in a conflict-torn zone.

titles.title: Bigg Boss: Agnipareeksha
titles.synopsis: The journey to Bigg Boss Malayalam 8 begins in Agnipareeksha, where commoner contestants battle for a place in the Bigg Boss House.

titles.title: The End of Oak Street
titles.synopsis: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

titles.title: The Rivals of Amziah King
titles.synopsis: Deep within the backwoods of rural Oklahoma, charismatic and musically gifted Amziah King herds a bluegrass-playing band of misfits while overseeing the premier honey-making operation in town. When Amziah’s estranged foster daughter unexpectedly returns, Amziah leaps at the possibility to renew connection and create a family business. But the honey game is ruthless, and Amziah’s rivals threaten to destroy everything he has built.

titles.title: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
titles.synopsis: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

titles.title: The Wrong Girls
titles.synopsis: Two codependent best friends living paycheck to paycheck and bong rip to bong rip get caught in a case of mistaken identity that throws their lives into chaos.

titles.title: The Birthday Party
titles.synopsis: The late 1970s, somewhere in the Mediterranean: Marcos Timoleon, a tycoon, is throwing a lavish, extravagant birthday party for Sofia on his exclusive private island. The party is a perfect excuse for various people in his life to approach him with their own agendas.

titles.title: Vishwanath & Sons
titles.synopsis: Sanjay Vishwanath is an acclaimed professional handgunner in his 40s with a major stake in fame and wealth. When he comes across a woman named Maddy in her 20s, their dynamic poses many issues that they must come to terms with.

titles.title: Nimrods
titles.synopsis: Three friends journey from Kansas City to Los Angeles, mistakenly believing that their band is opening for Green Day on New Year’s Eve.

titles.title: Awarapan 2
titles.synopsis: Shivam returns to the crime world, where his path forward demands redemption, love, and sacrifice. As relationships deepen and conflicts intensify, every choice tests his resolve and shapes his destiny.

titles.title: Keu Bole Biplobi, Keu Bole Dakat
titles.synopsis: A biopic of Ananta Singha. Some calls him dacoit, some calls him a rebellion. This adaptation gives the viewer a chance to know him as a whole, a person and as a revolutionary communist leader.

titles.title: Whitmer Thomas: Terminal Crew of Dudes
titles.synopsis: Comedian, musician, and actor Whitmer Thomas digs into his small-town Alabama upbringing and his ongoing quest to be cool.

titles.title: Magudam
titles.synopsis: Peaceful medical representative and shipping harbor worker Linga's life changes because of betrayal and conflict in a coastal community.

titles.title: Madhuramee Jeevitham
titles.synopsis: Madhuramee Jeevitham is a poignant family drama that explores aging, relationships, and the quiet beauty of everyday life.

titles.title: My Best Friend, His Girlfriend and Me
titles.synopsis: Olli and Matze are best friends living, working and planning to travel the world together — until Matze's romance with Rebecca turns it all upside down.

titles.title: All Wishes Come True!
titles.synopsis: Eight grassroot mortals use their street smarts and hilarious schemes to defy powerful gods, earning their title as the Eight Immortals.

titles.title: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
titles.synopsis: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..

titles.title: Elijah Peel
titles.synopsis: A stadium-filling rock star, Elijah Peel is at the top of the world … until his addiction leads to a heart attack that could cost him everything. During his recovery, Elijah encounters a remarkable young girl whose unwavering faith, radiant spirit, and wisdom beyond her years begin to break through the walls he has built around his heart. Her extraordinary hope and their unexpected bond inspire Elijah to begin a powerful journey toward healing, reconciliation, and faith.

titles.title: People & Things
titles.synopsis: A group of twenty-somethings navigate heartache, burnout and digital gloom as they search for meaning, connection and themselves in modern day Los Angeles.

titles.title: Sammarth
titles.synopsis: When an unexpected turn of events shatters a young civil engineer's life, he is forced to confront his past, his beliefs, and his destiny.

titles.title: Aali
titles.synopsis: Mulla (Aali), a sound engineer near the Tamil Nadu-Kerala border, falls for Ebby Mathew, an Ayurveda doctor working in Dubai. Facing family opposition and pressure to accept other matches, she plans to elope with him. Whether he returns in time, and whether their plan succeeds, forms the story's core.

titles.title: Pallaburusu
titles.synopsis: A 70 year old widower asks his son to buy him a toothbrush for his toothache. When the son fails to do this simple errand, their already strained father-son relationship becomes comically worse through a series of escalating events.

titles.title: The Brink of War
titles.synopsis: President Ronald Reagan races against time to salvage a deal with Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev that could dismantle nuclear arsenals—or ignite disaster. With pressure mounting on all sides, every word spoken brings the world closer to peace... or destruction.

titles.title: The Rotten Files with Stephanie Soo
titles.synopsis: Stephanie Soo dives deep into today's most explosive cases to uncover killers and predators who thought their stories would stay buried.

titles.title: The Sex Slave
titles.synopsis: A harrowing two-part documentary chronicling how a mother of five suddenly found herself being sold to unknown men... by her own partner.

titles.title: Batwara 1947
titles.synopsis: The story of an elderly Hindu woman who refuses to leave her ancestral home in Lahore, only to have a Muslim refugee family from Lucknow allotted to her house following the events of the 1947 Partition of India and Pakistan.

titles.title: Fast
titles.synopsis: For Sterling, a sort of present-day Alice, the graveyard Lotus she redeems becomes a totem, a saturated phenomenon permitting her to move freely in time on a phantom road. It is a sort of Ford but never a DeLorean. A Southern woman with a fair deal of historical baggage and deep secrets, Sterling journeys back to her rural home, the Lotus takes her through the shadow of the valley into the adjoining worlds of the living and the dead. Desiring to become an F1 driver, Sterling must go fast/hard, against/through all tunnels imagined or concrete.

titles.title: Katseye: Wild Hearts
titles.synopsis: A celebration to the group's new era and the fans who made it possible. Features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, Eyekons fan videos, and intimate interviews with the members.

titles.title: Inferno
titles.synopsis: Twenty years after a mysterious energy-gathering event, Dante remains haunted by what he witnessed that night. Withdrawn and unstable, he can no longer distinguish memory from hallucination. As his children investigate the tragedy that fractured their family, they uncover a past shaped by suppressed memories, guilt, and unresolved consequences. Meanwhile, Dante is pursued by Virgil, a spectral presence who acts as both guide and tormentor. Through a series of psychological trials, Virgil forces him to confront his distorted recollections, moral failures, and the truth of what happened in 2022. As past and present collide, Dante and his children must face their conflicting versions of the truth—and discover whether understanding it will bring forgiveness and redemption or cost them their sanity.

titles.title: Redux entity
titles.synopsis: Arjun, a young cab driver, is winding down after a long night shift when he accepts one more ride request. What starts as a routine late-night fare quickly turns strange — the pickup location doesn’t match what he expects, and things escalate from there into something eerie and increasingly out of his control

titles.title: Detective Teekshanaa
titles.synopsis: Every husband has detective wife. A proper detective role has become super at every stage.

titles.title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
titles.synopsis: After years of slapdash sequels and waning fandom, the Camp Miasma slasher franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. But when she visits the original's star, a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.

titles.title: The Fence
titles.synopsis: Horn is welcoming his partner Léone into the hut he shares with Cal, when a man called Alboury appears. He stays there until they return the body of his brother, who was killed on the site.

titles.title: Late Fame
titles.synopsis: Legendary New York poet Ed Saxberger's forgotten works captivate an eccentric group of young creatives, reigniting his artistic passion. Their intrigue intertwines with the bewitching presence of actress Gloria.

titles.title: Tony
titles.synopsis: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

titles.title: 120 Bahadur
titles.synopsis: Valiant Indian soldiers fight against Chinese troops during the 1962 Sino-Indian War, preventing a potential occupation of Ladakh region in the Battle of Rezang La.

titles.title: Ayogya 2
titles.synopsis: Follows Siddhegowda as he navigates the challenges and responsibilities of public life after becoming a Gram Panchayat member.

titles.title: ChaO
titles.synopsis: In a futuristic world where humans and mermaids coexist, the life of mild-mannered office worker Stephan is upended when he is suddenly proposed to by Chao — a princess from the mermaid kingdom. With no time to make sense of what's happening, Stephan soon finds himself living with the unpredictable, wholehearted Chao, and her sincere love begins to break down his emotional barriers.

titles.title: Korean Kanakaraju
titles.synopsis: Possessed by a Korean spirit, Kanakaraju must navigate his new supernatural identity to protect his family and solve the spirit's murder.

titles.title: One Night Only
titles.synopsis: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

titles.title: KJQ
titles.synopsis: Two close friends become entangled in a high-stakes conflict driven by power, ego, and vengeance, exploring how circumstances shape human nature.

titles.title: DC
titles.synopsis: Rebel Devadas joins forces with Chandra in a dangerous world where passion and peril collide. Their turbulent alliance demands bloodshed and tests loyalties as survival becomes the ultimate stake in their fight.

titles.title: G.D.N
titles.synopsis: Based on the life of G.D. Naidu, the 'Edison of India', dramatising his groundbreaking innovations, his industrial contributions, and conflicts with authorities—including struggles where his work and international dealings faced severe scrutiny and opposition.

titles.title: Thudakkam
titles.synopsis: When danger strikes, a young woman fights to survive through courage and determination.

titles.title: Cookie Queens
titles.synopsis: A celebration of girlhood and the complexities that come with it, Cookie Queens is a coming-of-age story about the joys, pressures, and tensions woven into one of America’s most cherished rituals: Girl Scout Cookie season.

titles.title: A Child of My Own
titles.synopsis: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.

titles.title: The Great Punjab Robbery
titles.synopsis: Three robbers with strange names seize an ordinary bank in Punjab. No demands. No ransom. Just cryptic riddles sent to the cops, each one leading deeper into the mystery.

titles.title: THE RIBBON HERO
titles.synopsis: When the monstrous Nergal devastates her kingdom, Princess Sapphire reawakens as the Ribbon Hero and fights to save her new home from the same dark fate.

titles.title: Hanuman Ansh
titles.synopsis: A grieving boy seeks God to meet his departed mother, and in finding the divine, learns to serve humanity with miracles of love, food and silent blessings, becoming Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba.

titles.title: Aryabhatt Ka Zero
titles.synopsis: A directionless young man from a middle-class family struggles to find his place in a world that has already written him off. As life tests his resilience, he embarks on a heartfelt journey of self-discovery, hope, and finding the courage to believe in himself.

titles.title: Get Set Go
titles.synopsis: A wild adventure where one pedal stroke could change everything.

titles.title: Photographer
titles.synopsis: Photographer follows Veera, a troubled and obsessive photographer determined to prove his worth in a world that has long dismissed him. Driven by ambition and haunted by a painful past, he ventures deep into Mathikettan Solai, a mysterious reserve forest, to capture a rare and elusive natural phenomenon that could change his life forever.

titles.title: Amader 7 Kahon
titles.synopsis: A SSR Cinemas Pvt Ltd production.

titles.title: Picture
titles.synopsis: Picture is an upcoming Kannada romantic comedy-drama that celebrates dreams, love, and family relationships with a wholesome entertainer.

titles.title: Awake
titles.synopsis: A corrupt police officer investigates his best friend's murder, getting involved in an underground drug ring in Southern Rhode Island.

titles.title: Yamudu
titles.synopsis: Yamudu follows Lord Yama's descent to earth to unleash brutal Garuda Purana punishments on the guilty. A police investigation and intertwining fates build toward a shocking revelation about who Yama truly is and the trauma behind his wrath.

titles.title: Super Troopers 3
titles.synopsis: When Farva's over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny's sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny's schemes to break up the relationship, all while trying to bring down a pernicious new drug ring.

titles.title: Deep6
titles.synopsis: An extraordinary story of an ordinary woman Mitul, who strives to change things which appear fossilized.

titles.title: Falcons
titles.synopsis: Andy is trained by his ex-hitman father to infiltrate Hell's Cartel, but when his sister is kidnapped and betrayal hits, the plan unravels, sparking the H-Game, turning child violence into global control.

titles.title: National Seating
titles.synopsis: Pleas Everson Sr. waxes poetically about his history of employment.

titles.title: Potato Salad
titles.synopsis: On Christmas Eve, a detective receives a call about a suicide that occurred during a dinner. When he arrives at the scene, he quickly realizes that something isn’t right and what appears to be a suicide may actually be something far more sinister.

titles.title: Solace
titles.synopsis: Framed by a speech given by the filmmaker’s brother at their uncle’s memorial service, this doc/fiction hybrid comedy blends archival family photos with surreal animated scripted scenes to explore outsized childhood fears, shifting family dynamics and intergenerational care.

titles.title: Ohh My Dog
titles.synopsis: In Assam, 14-year-old Apu embarks on a desperate quest to rescue his beloved dog, Momo, after he is kidnapped. Elsewhere, in Bihar, a devoted dog named Oscar sets out on a perilous journey to find his kidnapped owner, a 15-year-old child labourer. As their journeys unfold, it becomes clear that the two kidnappings may be connected to a larger, sinister plan.

titles.title: Devils Lake
titles.synopsis: When a group of kids go to the small town of Devils Lake for a bible camp, they are soon thrust into a cosmic reality of paranoia and terror following the mysterious death of their camp counselor.

titles.title: Ottamaram
titles.synopsis: It revolves around an elderly couple—Ravi and Bharathi—who have been living separately to cater to the needs and commitments of their children.

titles.title: Ice Cream Man
titles.synopsis: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

titles.title: The Lift
titles.synopsis: The world's first film shot entirely inside an elevator, from the brilliant mind of Sexocracy author Luca Redavid. Bologna, August 2, 1980. A terrifying roar shakes the central station, while six strangers remain trapped in a cabin just steps from hell. Isolated from the world in a claustrophobic space of just a few square meters, tensions rise to the limit as air runs out and help fails to arrive...

titles.title: Holy Father
titles.synopsis: A horror thriller from the makers of 'Holy Ghost'

titles.title: Oriental Hardon
titles.synopsis: Explores the “no Asians” ban through "gaysian nude archives."

titles.title: coool
titles.synopsis: an elsie fisher joint

titles.title: I Want Your Sex
titles.synopsis: When fresh-faced Elliot lands an exciting job for renowned artist, icon and provocateur Erika Tracy, his fantasies come true as Erika taps him to become her sexual muse. But Elliot soon finds himself out of his depth as Erika takes him on a journey more profound than he ever could have imagined, into a world of sex, obsession, power, betrayal and murder.

titles.title: The Gentleman Thief
titles.synopsis: A retired master thief must protect his impulsive brother from disaster when a 100 million dollar yacht heist spirals into a dangerous web of deception. Old foes emerge as the stakes rise, forcing him to use every trick he knows to stay alive.

titles.title: Analogue Natives
titles.synopsis: This experimental documentary circulates around interviews with four veterans who worked all their lives in analogue (=celluloid) film laboratories and animation studios in Mumbai, and who all lost their businesses and jobs around 2012–14, when the Hindi film industry went through a drastic shift to digital production. They reflect on the loss of their craftsmanship, but also on the philosophies of their handmade film practice versus readymade digital solutions. While the film drifts into various related and unrelated scenarios, shot on the streets of Mumbai, we learn about the art of living and working under precarious conditions in India and survival strategies in one of the most crowded and commercial cities in the world. Finally everything results in a futile collage of nostalgia and memories, mashed up with the absurd aesthetics of AI slop.  An expanded multi-genre documentary within the constraints of the so-called Masala Formula, popularly known from Indian cinema.

titles.title: Unmadham
titles.synopsis: A police constable reopens a long-forgotten case and experiences an unsettling world.

titles.title: Sheep in the Box
titles.synopsis: In the near future, architect Otone Komoto is married to Kensuke, who runs a construction company. The married couple decide to welcome a humanoid robot into their home as their son.

titles.title: Vestige
titles.synopsis: When a hooded figure steps into an abandoned house deep in the woods, flickering lights awaken memories of the family who once called it home.

titles.title: The Samurai and the Prisoner
titles.synopsis: When Lord Murashige rises up against the tyrannical Oda, he finds himself besieged within the walls of his own castle. Isolated, he is confronted with a series of mysterious crimes that shatter the fragile order of his court, plunging the fortress into fear and suspicion. With Oda's army closing in and a traitor hiding among his ranks, Murashige is forced into an uneasy alliance with Kanbei, a brilliant and dangerous strategist held prisoner in the dungeon, as he must outwit his enemies and uncover the truth before time runs out.

titles.title: Stay in the car
titles.synopsis: Set against the dim glow of streetlights and the hum of passing sirens, Stay in the Car captures one night in the life of a fifteen-year-old girl waiting in her mother's El Camino and the quiet reckoning that unfolds in the stillness. Based on real events, Stay in the Car explores the fragile line between safety and survival, love and neglect. It invites audiences into a world where survival depends on silence, and one young girl must decide whether to remain in her mother's chaos or step into her own uncertain freedom.

titles.title: HANDMEDOWN
titles.synopsis: An experimental micro-documentary and multigenerational handing down of queer sexual wisdom and whimsy.

titles.title: Transylvania Tapes
titles.synopsis: In 1997, Romanian actress Silvia Enescu mysteriously disappeared while searching for family property in Transylvania. All she left behind were a collection of home movies: the TRANSYLVANIA TAPES. Now, Silvia's daughter Mara travels from Los Angeles to Romania to discover what happened to her mother. With the help of her cameraman friend Dylan, Mara documents her journey, which takes her from the streets of Bucharest to the medieval town of Sighisoara, deep in the heart of Transylvania. Unearthing the truth about her mother comes at a terrible price, as Mara must escape an ancient family curse.

titles.title: Maaran
titles.synopsis: In a patriarchal society, two strangers - Birwa, a trafficking survivor, and Tara, who faces the same fate - are drawn into the path of a ruthless predator. Maaran exposes the devastating impact of gender-based violence and oppression.

titles.title: Tadviruddha
titles.synopsis: When a woman mysteriously disappears from a secluded coffee estate, suspicion falls on those closest to her. As a determined detective digs deeper, long-hidden secrets unravel in this psychological mystery.

titles.title: Newton's 3rd Law
titles.synopsis: Follows an investigation into a double murder in 1999, with unexpected characters roped into the case as they search for justice amid intrigue and secrets.

titles.title: Karmakhya
titles.synopsis: A mysterious visit to a grieving family pulls a young woman into a terrifying world of secrets, black magic, and haunting illusions. As disturbing events begin to blur the line between reality and nightmare, Kaamakhya finds herself trapped in a chilling chain of events rooted in a dark past that refuses to stay buried.

titles.title: Mamachya Govyala Jauya
titles.synopsis: Three friends win a free Goa trip and invite an old college buddy who brings a surprise guest. Their dream vacation turns into chaos as plans unravel. The unexpected companion becomes both the trip's highlight and its downfall.

titles.title: Jolly
titles.synopsis: In an age where love and marriages crumble over broken trust, Jolly and Jaanu build theirs on the one thing missing everywhere else — complete faith in each other.

titles.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
titles.synopsis: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.
